name: goldilocks
description: A lean Superpowers-compatible workflow suite with dynamic process depth and constant quality standards.

interface.longDescription: Provides thirteen familiar workflow entry skills plus a Goldilocks router backed by six shared progressive-disclosure engines. It preserves brainstorming, planning, debugging, TDD, worktrees, delegation, review, verification, branch finishing, and skill-writing coverage while avoiding unnecessary ceremony and context loading.
defaultPrompt: Use the smallest workflow that preserves full quality.
Plan and execute this without unnecessary process overhead.
Replace a Superpowers workflow with the equivalent Goldilocks entry.
